outcomes.name: illness_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' illness duration class: DI_1 1-3 days, DI_2 4-6, DI_3 more than 7

outcomes.name: habitus_raw
outcomes.definition: Habitus cell as written in the file (1+ to 4+ or COLLAPSED)

outcomes.name: habitus_score
outcomes.definition: Admission mental status (habitus) graded by the authors: 4 bright, alert and responsive; 3 mildly depressed; 2 and 1 severely depressed; 0 = 'COLLAPSED' in the file (coded 0 here; the authors class it with <2+). Higher is brighter

outcomes.name: habitus_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' habitus class: BAR (4+), Mi_De (3+), De_Co (2+ or less, or collapsed)

outcomes.name: anaemia_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' anaemia grade from haematocrit: Ht_N, Ht_Mi, Ht_Mo, Ht_S, Ht_VS

outcomes.name: wcc_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' white cell class: WCC_Lo (<6), WCC_N, WCC_Hi (>15 x10^9/L)

outcomes.name: band_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' band neutrophil class: BaN_N (0-0.5), BaN_H (>0.5 x10^9/L)

outcomes.name: left_shift_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' left shift class: L_shft (bands > 0.5), De_L_shift (bands > segmented); empty = none

outcomes.name: monocyte_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' monocyte class: Mon_N, Mon_Hi (>1.35 x10^9/L)

outcomes.name: arc_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' reticulocyte class: ARC_In (<80), ARC_Mi, ARC_Mo, ARC_Ma (>300 x10^9/L)

outcomes.name: arc_class_2
outcomes.definition: Authors' second reticulocyte class: ARC_Lo (<12.86), ARC_N, ARC_Hi (>115.41 x10^9/L)

outcomes.name: globulin_class
outcomes.definition: Authors' globulin class: Glo_Lo (<20), Glo_N, Glo_Hi (>41 g/L)
